Name: Critical Crow  - CR rarecrows for content patcher
Author: leonaryquinoy
Description:
Looking for some heroes to defend your crops from crows? Here's a good bunch for the job.

Changes each of the rarecrows in the game into a Critical Role (season 1) character, which are:
﻿Vax
﻿Vex
﻿Pike
﻿Scanlan
﻿Keyleth
﻿Grog
Percival Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III of Whitestone
﻿Gilmore

This is my first mod that I'm publishing and I'm still learning SDV modding, so this is by no means perfect. I'll probably update at some point to improve some stuff, but for now hopefully someone gets a kick out of this. 

This is for SDV version 1.3 and it mods the craftables.xnb, so if you have something else modding that file, this might interfere.

[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[/list]﻿
Life needs things to live. Crops need scarecrows to live.
